text: Watching one AI helper is easy.
DeepSeek's Super-agent tries to fix that.
Before, you sat with each AI coding session and told it every step.
DeepSeek's team says one person can keep track of only three to five at once.
Super-agent splits the job in two.
One router agent stays in your team chat and on Git-Hub.
When an allowed teammate asks for something, it opens a ticket and hands it to a worker: a separate agent with its own session and its own folder.
Many workers run at the same time.
The router stays quiet until a result is ready.
Super-agent asks for it only when a person must decide, or can use a result.
It is an open-source research prototype for one Git-Hub repo.
Ask your coding agent to read its setup file and set it up with you.
Next time: what a coding agent session really is.
